description: Returns UrbIN Networks articles and press releases from urbinnetworks.com (title, URL, date, summary), newest first, and how to get detailed route maps (shared after a non-disclosure agreement). Optional: query (keyword in title or summary), type, limit.

query.description: Optional keyword to match in titles and summaries, e.g. "latency", "resilience", "hyperscale".

type.description: Which kind of material to list. Default all.

name: list_resources
